Looking for your favourite bands that you’ve seen maybe in the 70s, 80s, 90s, 00s, 10s… that blew you away. Live vocals or guitar riffs that match or even exceed the studio versions.
 My choice would be Rush. 
 EDIT: Thanks everybody for your contributions.
 Here is the /r/musicsuggestions top 10 from this thread (ranked by a simple combination of mentions and upvotes):
 🥇 Grateful Dead
 🥈 Phish
 🥉 Tool
  
Rush
 
The Cure
 
Nine Inch Nails
 
Ween
 
Pearl Jam
 
Queens of the Stone Age
 
Primus
 
 Really interesting how it’s skewed toward jam/prog/alt culture…
 Honorable mentions: My Morning Jacket, Radiohead, Bruce Springsteen, Gogol Bordello, U2, Flaming Lips, Metallica, Spoon, Pink Floyd, LCD Soundsystem, Dave Matthews Band
